kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the block's header + three-row table.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the drug table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The SYMPATHETIC-DIMMER frame — α2 read as the sympathetic volume knob: the presynaptic autoreceptor is the negative-feedback brake (both printed: 'presynaptic α2-autoreceptors → negative feedback.', book 238; '↓ sympathetic (adrenergic) outflow', book 237), and the agonists are the hand that pulls it — turn α2 ON and the amp goes DOWN (↓ outflow → ↓ HR, ↓ BP). The CENTRAL/medullary location of the clonidine effect (the CNS site whose stimulation produces sympatholysis) is NOT printed on this page — flagged as KYP wherever used, never cited as printed. The dimmer reading itself — one receptor, one direction, whole-body consequences — is KYP's compression of three printed anchors (the autoreceptor sentence, the α2/Gi row, the distribution row).
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the brake on book 238 and the α2 row on book 237; the single-knob frame that unifies them with this page's drug table is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] + mnemonics[1] + the visual's mechanism strip

kypExtensions.summary: The PATIENT-SORT frame — the three rows read as WHO-gets-WHAT: the PREGNANT patient → α-methyldopa ('Hypertension in pregnancy'); the CHILD with ADHD or tics → guanfacine/clonidine ('ADHD, Tourette syndrome'); the WITHDRAWING patient → clonidine ('symptom control in opioid withdrawal'); the SPASTIC patient → tizanidine ('Relief of spasticity'); the urgency-HTN patient → clonidine ('Hypertensive urgency (limited situations)'). Every drug and use is the book's own print; the who-sort that turns four rows into four patient stems is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the rows by drug; the patient-first sort the exam actually tests is KYP's overlay.
kypExtensions.location: usmle pivots + traps + the visual's drug cards

kypExtensions.summary: The MOM-AND-COOMBS frame — α-methyldopa's two printed identities compressed: the pregnancy antihypertensive ('Hypertension in pregnancy' — the safe-in-pregnancy answer, versus the contraindicated ACE inhibitors/ARBs whose fetopathy is that topic's own) and the Coombs-positive drug ('Direct Coombs ⊕ hemolysis, drug-induced lupus, hyperprolactinemia' — the autoimmune triad: hemolytic anemia with the positive direct Coombs test, the lupus mimic, the prolactin story). Both identities are the book's own print; the MOM-AND-COOMBS compression is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints use and toxicity in adjacent cells; the one-phrase frame that carries both is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics[2] + usmle patterns[1] + the miniCase + the visual's methyldopa card

kypExtensions.summary: Two census flags: (1) the PRODRUG flag — α-methyldopa is converted (decarboxylated/hydroxylated) to α-methylnorepinephrine, a false neurotransmitter that stimulates the central α2 receptor — this reading is NOT printed on this page or its anchor pages and is flagged as KYP wherever used; (2) the PH22/alpha-blockers BOUNDARY CENSUS itself — pdf 265 (book 243) prints TWO separable sections under the one banner, and the inventory's two book-243 topics ARE separable on inspection: THIS topic (sympatholytics-alpha-2-agonists) = the UPPER block (header + three-row DRUG table, lines 9-37); the PENDING 'alpha-blockers' topic = the LOWER class table (lines 39-78) — EXCLUDED here, pinned from above so no double coverage arises (its last row, mirtazapine the α2 ANTAGONIST, is the receptor mirror of this block's agonists — cited as boundary only).
kypExtensions.rationale: The prodrug mechanism and the boundary split/mutual-exclusion documentation are pipeline curation and pharmacology-knowledge overlay, not book print.
kypExtensions.location: manifest notes + mechanisms[1] + traps + the visual's boundary strip

notes: Census (pdfimages + text layer): the Sympatholytics (α2-agonists) block occupies the UPPER portion of pdf 265 (book 243) under the standing 'PHARMACOLOGY—AUTONOMIC DRUGS' banner (lines 9-37), and prints: the section header 'Sympatholytics (α2-agonists)'; ONE THREE-COLUMN TABLE (DRUG / APPLICATIONS / ADVERSE EFFECTS) of three rows — 'Clonidine, guanfacine' → 'Hypertensive urgency (limited situations), ADHD, Tourette syndrome, symptom control in opioid withdrawal' | 'CNS depression, bradycardia, hypotension, respiratory depression, miosis, rebound hypertension with abrupt cessation'; 'α-methyldopa' → 'Hypertension in pregnancy' | 'Direct Coombs ⊕ hemolysis, drug-induced lupus, hyperprolactinemia'; 'Tizanidine' → 'Relief of spasticity' | 'Hypotension, weakness, xerostomia'. RASTER CENSUS: ZERO raster images on pdf 265 (pdfimages -list returns no rows) — the block is PURE TEXT, COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced as artwork; carried VERBATIM as the note's two table blocks (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION) and conveyed as ONE original KYP mechanism map (Alpha2AgonistMap). BOUNDARY, pinned from above: the LOWER portion of the same page (lines 39-78) is the α-blockers class table — the SEPARATE PENDING 'alpha-blockers' topic (Nonselective phenoxybenzamine/phentolamine; 'α1 selective (-osin ending)' prazosin/terazosin/doxazosin/tamsulosin; 'α2 selective' mirtazapine) — EXCLUDED here; only its header pair + first/last drug rows pinned as boundary markers (mirtazapine is the α2 ANTAGONIST mirror of this block's agonists — cited as boundary only, its rows never as this block's print). SECTION EXTENT: the block does NOT extend to pdf 266 (book 244 opens 'β-blockers', the PENDING beta-blockers topic); pdf 264 (book 242) behind carries only the tail of the COMPLETED pilot sympathomimetics (the physiologic-effects figure captions); sourcePages = [265] only. CROSS-PAGE ANCHORS (all printed, all verified): pdf 260/book 238 (COMPLETED autonomic-drugs, PH17) — 'Release of norepinephrine from a sympathetic nerve ending is modulated by NE itself, acting on presynaptic α2-autoreceptors → negative feedback.' (the block's own mechanism sentence); pdf 259/book 237 (COMPLETED g-protein-linked-second-messengers, PH16) — the α2 row 'α2 | i | ↓ sympathetic (adrenergic) outflow, ↓ insulin release, ↓ lipolysis, ↑ platelet aggregation, ↓ aqueous humor production' + the figure labels 'M2, α2, or D2 receptor' → 'Gi protein' (α2 = the Gi couple); pdf 258/book 236 (COMPLETED tissue-distribution-of-adrenergic-receptors, PH15) — the α2 distribution row 'Pancreas / Presynaptic terminals / Salivary glands' → 'Inhibition of insulin secretion / Inhibition of neurotransmitter release / Inhibition of salivary secretion'. KYP extensions flagged wherever they appear: the SYMPATHETIC-DIMMER frame (the central/medullary location of the clonidine effect is NOT printed — flagged), the PATIENT-SORT frame (who-gets-what reading of the printed rows), the MOM-AND-COOMBS frame (the pregnancy-sort + the Coombs lab), the PRODRUG flag (α-methyldopa → α-methylnorepinephrine, the false-neurotransmitter reading — NOT printed, flagged), and the PH22/alpha-blockers boundary census.
